title: Extensions of One-Sided Box Geometry and Pyramid Invariants to gd-Sets and qm-Spaces
summary: Domination of gd-sets, the relation recording which function family approximates which, is closed under box convergence. More generally, approximate 1-Lipschitz maps on asymptotically full-measure subsets, whose restricted measures converge to the target measure after pushforward, place the target representation in every subsequential weak limit of the source pyramids.
